thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate (502/504) observed for requests served from eu-west-2 subnets in VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d. Affected: customer-facing inference endpoints (redwood-api-prod). Threshold: >5% 5xx over 1m.

maya_sre: Paging oncall. I'm taking this. Looking at metrics and netflow.

oliver_net: I see spike in SYN+ACK mismatches from az2a -> az2b. Possibly asymmetric return path. traceroute from az2a to backend shows next-hop drop.

maya_sre: Can someone post sample traceroute / tcpdump? Also possible terraform route table update rolled out at 03:12 UTC.

jordan_infra: FYI deploys: terraform apply completed at 03:11:54 by infra-pipeline. Route changes in module 'vpc-routing' (changed route priority for route table rtb-0d9f). Rolling forward.

lucy_support: Customer impact: ~12% of requests from EU customers getting timeouts/5xx, multiple support tickets from enterprise customers. Escalated to SE team.

maya_sre: Running tcpdump on an affected host (app-euw2-az2a):
```
# tcpdump -n -i eth0 'tcp port 443'
14:03:21.123456 IP 10.0.32.12.56324 > 10.0.48.80.443: Flags [S], seq ...
14:03:21.223789 IP 10.0.48.80.443 > 10.0.32.12.56324: Flags [R], seq ...
```
We're seeing RSTs from hosts in az2b back to az2a.

oliver_net: That matches: control plane shows route table rtb-0d9f associated with private subnet subnet-az2a was changed to point to NAT gateway in az2b instead of local AZ NAT. conntrack drop because source/destination check logic failing when return path uses a different NAT.

maya_sre: OK hypothesis: terraform changed route association so az2a private subnet egress now exits via az2b NAT gateway (cross-AZ NAT). AWS conntrack issues cause established connections to be reset. Impact limited to cross-AZ egress to internet (external model fetches, metrics, telemetry) -> 5xx upstream. Need immediate mitigation: re-associate route table back to original or create AZ-local NAT.

jordan_infra: I'm reverting the terraform change now. Rolling back route table association for subnet-az2a.

incident-bot: Deploy rollback triggered by jordan_infra. Runbook: rollback-apply v1.2. ETA ~3m.

maya_sre: Temp mitigation if rollback fails: modify route table to point to NAT gateway nat-az2a-01 manually and pin it. Also we can update autoscaling to drain affected hosts if needed.

oliver_net: Opening AWS support ticket: case# 1234567890 - reporting conntrack asymmetry with cross-AZ NAT causing RSTs. @aws_support_bot please assist with conntrack logs.

aws_support_bot: Case created 1234567890. AWS Support asking for packet captures and route table diff. Provide VPC flow logs. ETA initial response 15m.

jordan_infra: Rollback applied at 03:18:06. Re-associating rtb-0d9f -> subnet-az2a completed. Verifying.

maya_sre: Checking metrics... error rate dropping from 12% -> 3% over last 90s. P95 latency normalizing.

lucy_support: Notifying impacted customers: sent templated update to affected accounts explaining transient networking issue and mitigation. PRD ticket created.

rick_prod: Any signal that this will reoccur on next terraform apply? Need permanent guardrails.

oliver_net: Action items: 1) Add terraform plan policy to prevent route re-association across-az without approval. 2) Create alert for cross-AZ NAT associations. 3) Add conntrack-safe fallback where returning traffic uses same AZ NAT or ENI-based SNAT. 4) Post-mortem.

maya_sre: Creating incident timeline and will handoff to postmortem owner. Taking oncall handoff to oliver_net for networking follow-up.

oliver_net: Taking post-incident ownership. I'll coordinate with infra to update TF modules and run a canary in eu-west-2.

lucy_support: Support will follow up with affected customers with root cause and remediation plan.

maya_sre: Thanks team. Closing active paging. If errors spike again re-open. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident Severity: SEV2 -> Resolved (mitigated) at 03:22:11 UTC. Timeline and notes attached.

oliver_net: Notes for postmortem: include exact terraform plan diff, NAT gateway failover behavior docs, and test cases to run in staging with cross-az route associations.

maya_sre: Filing postmortem ticket #INC-2026-042 in incidents board and assigning to oliver_net. Please add runbook updates and TFGuard policy.

lucy_support: I'll attach customer timeline and support tickets to the postmortem.

jordan_infra: Adding a check to the infra pipeline to block route-table re-association without explicit tag 'allow-cross-az' and add a tfplan automated reviewer.

oliver_net: Also recommending an observable: per-subnet egress nat-gateway ID metric so we can detect cross-az egress quickly.

maya_sre: Great. End of thread.
